tracking-prevention.description: Microsoft Edge's built-in blocking of known web trackers. Administrators care because its level can break sites and can be set by policy.

transcript-api.label: Transcript API
transcript-api.description: Programmatic access to Teams meeting transcripts for apps and agents.

transcripts.label: Transcripts
transcripts.description: Written records of meetings and calls, and whether they are saved.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.description: Events or schedules that start an agent or flow without a person asking.

ui-automation.label: UI automation
ui-automation.description: Automating applications by driving their user interface, as desktop flows do.

unified-routing.label: Unified routing
unified-routing.description: The Dynamics 365 service that routes and assigns incoming conversations to queues and representatives, and a prerequisite for conversation orchestration.

universal-print.label: Universal Print
universal-print.description: Microsoft's cloud printing service for Microsoft 365 and Windows; administrators manage printers, shares and print settings in the cloud rather than on print servers.

unlicensed-users.label: Unlicensed users
unlicensed-users.description: People who can be referenced or reached by a feature without holding a licence for it.

usage-based-billing.label: Usage-based billing
usage-based-billing.description: Paying per unit of use, metered after the event, rather than a flat licence.

usage-reports.label: Usage reports
usage-reports.description: Admin centre reports showing who used a feature, how much, and what it cost.

user-confirmation.label: User confirmation
user-confirmation.description: Copilot asks the user to approve before it writes or deletes data in an external system.

user-experience.label: User experience
user-experience.description: A change to how a feature looks or behaves for the people using it.

user-profiles.label: User profiles
user-profiles.description: The profile data kept about each person, including SharePoint custom properties. Administrators care because search and Copilot can surface it.

user-reported-messages.label: User reported messages
user-reported-messages.description: Suspicious email that users report from Outlook and that admins review and answer in Defender; administrators care because the result emails shape user trust in reporting.

vdi.label: Virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI)
vdi.description: Hosted virtual desktops such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix and Omnissa Horizon, where Teams media optimisation decides call quality and network paths.

verified-id.label: Microsoft Entra Verified ID
verified-id.description: Microsoft's verifiable-credentials service, used with Face Check to prove who a user is; administrators care because it carries its own licence terms.

version-history.label: Version history
version-history.description: The stored earlier versions of SharePoint and OneDrive files, and the limits and trim jobs that decide how many are kept and how much storage they use.

views.label: Views
views.description: Saved lists of records in model-driven apps, now with calendar and card layouts.

visio.label: Microsoft Visio
visio.description: Microsoft's diagramming application, available as a desktop app and on the web; administrators care because diagrams often hold network and process detail.

viva-amplify.label: Microsoft Viva Amplify
viva-amplify.description: Viva app for planning communication campaigns and publishing them to Outlook, Teams and SharePoint; admins decide who can create campaigns.

viva-connections.label: Viva Connections
viva-connections.description: The Microsoft Teams employee experience app, powered by a SharePoint home site. Admins care because its management is moving between admin centres.

viva-engage.label: Viva Engage
viva-engage.description: Microsoft's community and conversation app in Microsoft 365; administrators care because feed and community changes reach every user.

viva-feature-access-management.label: Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM)
viva-feature-access-management.description: The policy system in the Microsoft 365 admin center and PowerShell that turns Viva features on or off for the tenant, groups or users.

viva-glint.label: Microsoft Viva Glint
viva-glint.description: Microsoft's employee survey and listening product; administrators care because it holds employee HR attributes and survey data.

viva-insights.label: Microsoft Viva Insights
viva-insights.description: The Viva Insights web app hosts the Copilot Dashboard and Agent Dashboard that report adoption and usage; administrators control who sees which views.

viva-pulse.label: Microsoft Viva Pulse
viva-pulse.description: Microsoft Viva Pulse sends short employee surveys; administrators care because it collects feedback from staff and has its own privacy thresholds and access controls.

voice-and-face-recognition.label: Voice and face recognition
voice-and-face-recognition.description: Teams features that match enrolled voice and face profiles to people in meeting rooms; administrators care because they use biometric data and have their own enrolment controls.

watermarking.label: Watermarking
watermarking.description: A visible overlay of text on protected content that discourages sharing; administrators care because it only shows where a restriction policy applies.

weaponizable-file-protection.label: Weaponizable File Protection
weaponizable-file-protection.description: Teams protection that blocks messages carrying file types commonly used for malware; administrators care because it applies to chats and channels, including external collaboration.

web-api.label: Web API
web-api.description: The REST interface for reading and writing Dataverse or Power Pages data.

web-browsing.label: Web browsing (agents)
web-browsing.description: An agent visiting live websites to read or act, with the data exposure that implies.

web-grounding.label: Web grounding
web-grounding.description: Copilot sending a query to Bing to improve an answer. Administrators can turn it off or exclude domains.

web-roles.label: Web roles
web-roles.description: Power Pages' permission groups for site visitors, which decide what each visitor can see and do.

web-search.label: Web search
web-search.description: Copilot or an agent searching the public web as part of answering.

windows-11.label: Windows 11
windows-11.description: Windows 11 devices and the Windows-level features that Intune and other tools configure on them.

windows-autopatch.label: Windows Autopatch
windows-autopatch.description: Microsoft's cloud service that orchestrates Windows updates through Intune; administrators meet it as the engine behind quality update policies.

windows-hello-for-business.label: Windows Hello for Business
windows-hello-for-business.description: Device-bound, PIN or biometric sign-in to Microsoft Entra ID; administrators care because it can satisfy multifactor authentication and Conditional Access requirements.

windows-photos.label: Photos app for Windows
windows-photos.description: The Photos app on Windows 11, which can show local and OneDrive photos; administrators care because existing app and OneDrive policies decide how it behaves.

windows-quality-updates.label: Windows quality updates
windows-quality-updates.description: Monthly and out-of-band Windows servicing updates; administrators decide when each type reaches devices and who approves it.

windows-recall.label: Windows Recall
windows-recall.description: The Copilot+ PC feature that saves searchable snapshots of the screen on the device, and the policies that control it.

word.label: Microsoft Word
word.description: The Microsoft Word app; tagged on changes that affect how Word documents are created, shared or governed.

work-iq.label: Work IQ
work-iq.description: Microsoft's layer of work data, memory and skills that agents and Copilot draw on across Microsoft 365, exposed to agents through the Work IQ MCP server.

workflows.label: Copilot Studio workflows
workflows.description: The visual automation experience in Copilot Studio built on the Microsoft Copilot harness; administrators care because each action consumes Copilot Studio capacity.

workforce-management.label: Workforce management
workforce-management.description: Forecasting, shift scheduling and adherence tracking for contact-centre staff; administrators care because it governs staff schedules and supervisor alerts.

worldwide.label: Worldwide (commercial cloud)
worldwide.description: Microsoft's standard commercial cloud, where most organisations are. New features reach it first.

write-actions.label: Write actions
write-actions.description: An agent creating, updating or deleting data rather than only reading it. The highest-impact kind of action.
